bullets: Aion stacks mana regen on every cast and Arcane Resonance turns that regen into faster basic cooldowns, on top of Void Bomb's 4.7s cooldown from haste.
Each ability hit triggered Megacosm's max health burn, and Wraith Leggings added 12% damage on heroes under 40% health, so frequent Void Bombs kept both rolling.
Overseer makes Neural Disruptor deal 15% more and heal her for 25% of it, and Innovation resets the ultimate on a takedown, so kills chained into more blasts.
Krix's growing max health and Cannibalism's 25 max health per takedown enlarged Cybernetic Shell, a shield worth 7% of max health that refreshes when he avoids damage.
Tainted Guard cuts healing by 45% and bleeds anyone who basic attacks him, while Stonewall and his passive armor soaked those physical hits.
Heavy Metal adds 10% of his total armor as magic damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash, so armor bought for defense also fed his damage.
Re-Crunch's passive healed every third hit and Lich's magical lifesteal healed him off his empowered punches, so his health kept refilling through long brawls.
Mistmeadow Buckler can block up to 50% of incoming magical damage, so he could stay in the middle of fights while Re-Crunch's passive kept healing him.
Vesh, Mind Rot and Tainted Blade all fire on each ability hit, and Re-Crunch at about 13.8s repeated an ability to set them off again.
Press the Advantage drops a Rally Point on every takedown, speeding Legion's rifle fire and his allies' attack speed, so each kill fueled the next fight.
Every rifle shot set off Resolution, Mutilator and Infernum, and both Mutilator and Infernum's ignite deal damage based on enemy max health, punishing tanky frontliners.
With 50 ability haste Orbital Sanction came back in about 73.3s, and Spear Of Desolation added 10% damage for 6s after each cast.
